title: Clip-on Shoulder Module detailed design spec
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. The clip-on Shoulder Module needs attachment hardware to the Hip Belt, geometry and sizing. Depends on: ridebelt-design-001 (do those first or use their outputs if merged). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Write a detailed spec for the Shoulder Module: attachment points and connectors to the belt, strap geometry, sternum strap, sizes and bill of materials, consistent with design-002 where parts are shared.
acceptanceCriteria: Attachment cannot be mis-fitted (asymmetric or keyed)
Shares parts with design-002 where possible
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
